name: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach Providers
description: Adult-only Scarlet Peach stream providers for Nuvio. Hanime, HentaiHaven, and experimental HStream share the Scarlet Peach schema v2 metadata core and external identity bridge. HentaiHaven provides HLS/VP9 playback up to 1080p; HStream provides native DASH playback with proven 720p, 1080p, and 2160p/4K manifests where available and forwards discovered ASS subtitle tracks to Nuvio.

scrapers.name: Hanime
scrapers.description: Hanime provider for Scarlet Peach MAL/AniList/SP metadata, TMDB numeric IDs, IMDb IDs, and compatible legacy HentaiStream title slugs. Exact schema v2 Hanime episode mappings bypass catalog search and go directly to the signed AES-GCM handshake. Optional account settings authenticate directly from Nuvio to Hanime and pass only the temporary session token to the resolver for premium qualities. Stream labels follow the Nexus quality/audio standard and include verified censorship metadata when available.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach; protocol references from Yuzono AniYomi Hanime and anime-src/hanime-stremio

scrapers.name: HentaiHaven
scrapers.description: Production HentaiHaven provider. Uses hentaihaven.com first and hentaihaven.vip as a working mirror fallback with Romanization-aware matching, secure player token decoding, HLS extraction, Octopus VP9 1080p, one stream row per quality, provider-specific censorship detection, and live audio/subtitle metadata. Shared Scarlet Peach identity resolution keeps MAL/AniList/SP entries compatible with foreign TMDB/IMDb catalog IDs.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach; protocol references from cynthia2006/hanime-plugin and ngomile/anigrab HentaiHaven extractors

scrapers.name: HStream
scrapers.description: Experimental HStream provider using Scarlet Peach MAL/AniList/SP metadata plus the shared TMDB/IMDb ingress bridge. Resolves HStream episode pages through direct slug and search fallback, performs the XSRF-protected player API handshake, follows multiple CDN domains, and returns native DASH/MPD streams. Live tests currently prove 720p, 1080p, and 2160p/4K on supported titles, with provider-specific censorship, studio, frame-rate, and selectable ASS subtitle tracks forwarded to Nuvio.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach; protocol reference from cynthia2006/hanime-plugin HStream extractor
